# Mandatory Page Excellence Toolchain v1.1

Status: `ACTIVATION_CANDIDATE_FAIL_CLOSED`

This closed-world toolset makes architecture, implementation, runtime, and adoption evidence mandatory for page and interface mutations routed through `AI_ENTRYPOINT.json`.

The universal layer applies to every page. Named award adapters are separate, current-cycle overlays and are not implied by a universal pass.

## Permanent routing law

- No mandatory toolset route → no page construction.
- No implementation-class decision → no architecture approval.
- No existing-construct search → no replacement architecture.
- No exact source identities and adoption matrix → no existing-construct adoption claim.
- Wrong implementation class → fail closed regardless of generic quality score.
- Existing site constructs are implementation sources, not visual inspiration.
- No required phase receipts → no candidate materialization.
- No runtime evidence → no perceptual acceptance request.
- No acceptance → no public page mutation.

The official mutation entry command invokes `page-operation-entry-gate.v1.mjs`. It verifies the active closed-world toolset bundle, nine instrument registrations, version bindings, thresholds, page-operation phase, receipt bundle, implementation-class decision, existing-construct search, exact source identities, adoption matrix, visual-architecture authority, prohibited substitute architectures, and required runtime conditions before delegating to the existing repository project router.

## Contextual architecture conformance

The `contextualArchitectureConformanceInstrument` runs before design and remains binding through adoption. It accepts only:

- `EXISTING_CONSTRUCT_ADOPTION`
- `NEW_CONSTRUCT_SEPARATELY_AUTHORIZED`
- `NONVISUAL_CONTENT_ONLY`

`EXISTING_CONSTRUCT_ADOPTION` requires exact repository path, commit SHA, Git blob SHA, an implementation-source disposition, and a capability-level adoption matrix. A source cited only as inspiration is rejected. A content adapter cannot acquire visual-architecture authority from content ownership.

`NEW_CONSTRUCT_SEPARATELY_AUTHORIZED` requires a separate exact authority identity after a completed existing-construct search. Generic originality, craft, accessibility, performance, or composite scores cannot supply that authority.

The gate rejects unresolved implementation class, skipped construct search, missing adoption matrices, invented or moving source identities, pseudo-spatial substitutes, and visible command-driven navigation when direct manipulation is required by the adopted construct.

## Blind baseline subject

- Immutable visual subject: `2044e7ab5d27af7bcfbd477a6c3ee046549744ed`
- Packaging-only successor: `6c9f32d4ea13905b87f3519f9c18c425ae0e449c`
- User visual inspection: withheld during scoring.
- Screenshots: neither included nor exposed.

The workflow preserves deterministic package reproduction, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit runtime tests, phone/tablet/desktop equivalence, axe accessibility execution, keyboard behavior, exact-return scenarios, performance measurements, and two-holder score reproduction. It additionally performs two-holder contextual-routing reproduction and closes the exact repository-operation lock only after canonical equality.

Automated visual and originality scores remain bounded proxies. They do not create construct validity, human perceptual acceptance, or named-award readiness.
